title: Senior SRE ( DevOps)
description:
**about searce**

Searce is an AI outcome engineering company and a modern technology consultancy that helps enterprises futurify their business with AI, cloud and data. Founded in 2004, we are 1,300+ Searcians across 12 countries, with deep business process expertise, a Google Cloud Global MSP status and compliance credentials including PCI DSS and ISO 27001. We solve with our proprietary evlos™ problem-solving methodology: no bureaucratic fluff, working prototypes fast, and production scale that holds.

**about ATRE**

ATRE is Searce's AI Trust & Resilience Engineering practice: the managed-service team that keeps customers' cloud and AI estates secure, reliable and resilient 24x7. We are building it AI-first. Every engineer is expected to use AI tools and AIOps to raise efficiency, cut toil and shorten recovery time.

**role overview**

As a Senior Engineer you are the L3 backbone of the ATRE managed-service team. You resolve the complex incidents that L1/L2 cannot, find the root cause, and then automate the fix. You use AI tools and AIOps to work faster than manual operations allow, and you keep customer cloud and AI workloads secure and reliable.

**what you'll do**

* **L3 ownership:**
  Handle escalated Sev-1/Sev-2 incidents, drive them to resolution and own the follow-up.
* **Root cause analysis:**
  Run blameless post-incident reviews and implement long-term fixes that prevent recurrence.
* **AI-led efficiency:**
  Apply AI tools and AIOps to triage, correlate alerts, accelerate RCA and automate repeat work.
* **Automation:**
  Build reusable automation and runbooks in Terraform, Python or Bash to remove toil.
* **Platform operations:**
  Operate and secure Kubernetes (GKE) and cloud infrastructure, including patching, upgrades and DR drills.
* **Observability:**
  Maintain monitoring, alerting, SLIs and SLOs so issues surface before customers feel them.
* **Security hygiene:**
  Apply IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability remediation across customer environments.
* **Knowledge sharing:**
  Document solutions and help L1/L2 engineers grow.

**what you bring**

* **Delivery experience:**
  Hands-on production experience in SRE, DevOps or cloud operations, including real L3 incident handling.
* **Technical depth:**
  Strong in at least one hyperscaler (GCP preferred), Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.
* **Observability:**
  Hands-on with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK or similar.
* **Scripting:**
  Python or Bash for systems automation.
* **AI-led efficiency:**
  Practical experience using AI tools to improve SRE efficiency (AI-assisted runbooks, incident triage, RCA, automation) and/or AIOps platforms (e.g., BigPanda, Moogsoft, Dynatrace, Datadog), with measurable results such as lower MTTR, less toil or reduced alert noise.
* **Work mode:**
  Comfortable working from the office.

**good to have**

* Cloud certifications (e.g., Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure AZ-104/AZ-400)
* CKA / CKS
* Exposure to AI/LLM workload security
* On-call and 24x7 managed service experience

**why searce**

* **Solver mindset:**
  We hire solvers, not task-takers. You will be trusted to own problems end to end.
* **Not a CAVEr, say no to HiPPO:**
  We are not Citizens Against Virtually Everything, and the best idea wins over the highest-paid person's opinion.
* **AI-native practice:**
  ATRE is built around AI tools and AIOps from day one, so you build the future of managed services rather than inherit the past.
* **Learning and growth:**
  Partner-led certifications and exposure to Google Cloud, AWS, Databricks and Anthropic Claude ecosystems.
* **Culture:**
  HAPPIER values (humble, adaptable, positive, passionate, innovative, excellence, responsible).

title: L1/L2 Application support engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

**Job title : L1/L2 Application Support Engineer**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated and dynamic
**L1/L2 Application Support Engineer**
to join our technology team. In this role, you will be the frontline and second-line defense in ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of our enterprise applications. You will work closely with development, QA, infrastructure, and business teams to troubleshoot technical issues, manage deployments, support UAT cycles, and maintain smooth operations across production and non-production environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident & Problem Management**

* **Technical Issue Analysis:**
  Actively monitor applications, triage incoming alerts, and perform initial root-cause analysis for technical incidents across front-end and back-end modules.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:**
  Coordinate effectively with diverse internal and external teams to follow up on pending items, resolve bottlenecks, and drive incident resolution.
* **Communication:**
  Provide clear, timely updates to stakeholders and management regarding incident status, workaround availability, and resolution timelines.

**Deployments & Release Management**

* **CI/CD Pipelines:**
  Monitor and participate in CI/CD pipeline executions, ensuring smooth code transitions from development through staging to production.
* **Production Rollouts:**
  Assist in executing scheduled production rollouts, post-implementation validation, and rollback procedures if required.
* **UAT Support:**
  Provide dedicated support during User Acceptance Testing (UAT), helping validate fixes, troubleshoot environmental issues, and assist business users.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Architecture Understanding:**
  Basic working knowledge of front-end and back-end modules and how they interact within enterprise systems.
* **Database:**
  Proficiency in writing and executing database queries (e.g., SQL) for data retrieval, investigation, and troubleshooting, with hands-on knowledge of MariaDB. log analysis, file management, and process monitoring, alongside working knowledge of OpenShift (OCP) containers and POD deployments.
* **Integration Protocols:**
  Familiarity with system integrations over
  **HTTPS**
  (REST/SOAP APIs) and
  **SFTP**
  file transfers.
* **Tooling & Pipelines:**
  Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts, deployment workflows, and release cycles.

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* **Independent Execution:**
  Proven ability to work autonomously, take ownership of complex issues, and drive tasks through to resolution with minimal oversight.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical issues clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Follow-up & Accountability:**
  Strong organizational skills with the ability to persistently track, manage, and follow up on pending action items across multiple teams.
* **Problem Solving:**
  A methodical approach to troubleshooting and analyzing complex technical issues under pressure.

**Preferred Experience**

* 7 to 10 years of experience in IT application support, software maintenance, or a related technical operations role.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow) and enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, ELK stack, Kibana, Grey Logs).

title: L2 Support Engineer
description:
**About Clari5**
Clari5 is a technology company that specializes in providing real-time intelligence and analytics solutions primarily for the banking and financial services sector. They use AI & ML to help organizations detect and prevent fraud, enhance customer engagement, and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
**Key Features And Functionalities Of Clari5’s Offerings Include**

* Fraud Detection and Prevention: Clari5’s solutions use advanced algorithms to analyze transactions and user behavior in real time, identifying suspicious activities that may indicate fraudulent behavior.
* Customer Engagement: The platform helps banks and financial institutions understand customer behavior and preferences, enabling personalized product offerings and improving overall customer experience.
* Risk Management: Clari5 aids organizations in assessing and managing various risks, including credit and operational risks, by providing insights based on historical data and trends.
* Operational Efficiency: By automating repetitive tasks and streamlining processes, Clari5 helps organizations reduce costs and enhance productivity.
* Real-time Analytics: Clari5 provides real-time insights and analytics, allowing banks and financial institutions to make data-driven decisions promptly.

Overall, Clari5 aims to empower businesses in the financial sector by providing them with the analytical tools and intelligence needed to thrive in a competitive and rapidly changing Environment.
  
  
**Role: Support Engineer – L2**
**Exp: 4- 7 yrs**

* Intermediate level handles complex cases independently and mentors junior team Members.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Diagnose and resolve medium-complexity technical issues with minimal supervision.
* Conduct in-depth troubleshooting, including server logs, database queries, and application configurations.
* Take ownership of incidents, ensuring proactive follow-up and resolution.
* Actively prevent recurrence by contributing to preventive fixes.
* Create detailed Knowledge Base (KB) articles, how-to guides, and process documentation.
* Support the L1 team with mentoring and escalation assistance.
* Coordinate effective client communication during downtime or planned maintenance.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Linux/UNIX system administration, including service management.
* Good working experience with web servers/application servers (Apache, Tomcat, JBoss).
* Ability to write and execute structured SQL queries for troubleshooting.
* Strong scripting ability (e.g., Shell, Python).
* Experience using and configuring ticketing tools.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication, customer handling, and analytical thinking.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams effectively

**Preferred Skills**

* Some exposure to client-side implementation or onsite experience.
* Understanding of financial services or banking applications.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or equivalent.

**Additional Traits**

* Strong customer orientation and problem-solving mindset.
* High level of urgency and accountability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work in rotational shifts and handle on-call support.
* Willingness to travel when required.
* Fast learner with adaptability to new technologies.

title: Want to Build the Technology that could Reinvent 3PL & E-COMMERCE / Q-COMMERCE Supply Chains?
description:
**Senior Software Engineering:**

**E-Commerce Marketplaces & AI Supply chain & Logistics Tech Product Build**

**Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd. - www.goldfishh.com**

We’re looking for a senior technology builder who doesn’t just want to maintain software — but wants to
**architect and build technology products from the ground up.**

Goldfishh operates at the intersection of
**Supply Chain, Warehousing, 3PL, E-Commerce and Marketplace Commerce**
. As we scale our physical and digital ecosystem, we are embarking on an ambitious technology journey to build
**AI-powered platforms that can fundamentally change how businesses manage warehousing, fulfilment, logistics and marketplace commerce.**

We are looking for an experienced
**Software Engineering / Product Technology leader**
who wants to be part of this journey from an early stage.

**What You Will Build**

You will play a key role in architecting and developing technology platforms across:

•
**N2N / Multi-Sided Digital Marketplaces**
connecting businesses, service providers, infrastructure and supply-chain capacity.

•
**E-Commerce & Marketplace Technology**
integrating marketplaces, D2C platforms, OMS, WMS, inventory, fulfilment, advertising, pricing and revenue optimisation.

•
**Warehousing & 3PL Technology**
for distributed warehouse networks, fulfilment operations, inventory visibility and supply-chain orchestration.

•
**AI-Native Products & Agents**
using Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning, intelligent automation and agentic workflows.

•
**Data & Decision Intelligence**
capable of converting large volumes of operational, commercial and marketplace data into actionable recommendations.

•
**APIs & Integrations**
connecting ERP, WMS, OMS, TMS, marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, logistics partners and enterprise systems.

The objective is not simply to digitise existing processes.

**We want to rethink them.**

**Who We Are Looking For**

You should ideally have:

•
**10–15+ years of software engineering / technology product development experience.**

• BE / BTech or equivalent engineering degree, preferably from a
**premier engineering institution**
.

• Strong hands-on experience architecting and building
**scalable technology products**
, preferably within technology startups or high-growth product companies.

• Proven experience with
**N2N / B2B / B2C marketplaces, e-commerce platforms or multi-sided digital ecosystems**
.

• Strong understanding of modern
**cloud-native architecture, APIs, microservices, databases and scalable distributed systems**
.

• Practical experience designing or building products using
**Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, machine learning or AI-driven automation**
.

• Ability to think simultaneously as a
**Product Architect, Software Engineer and Technology Innovator**
.

• Experience taking products from
**concept → architecture → MVP → production → scale**
.

Most importantly, you should still enjoy
**building**
.

We are not looking for someone whose role has become entirely managerial. We want a senior technologist who can define architecture, make critical engineering decisions, work with developers and remain close to the product and the code.

**Technology Stack & AI-Native Architecture**

We intend to build Goldfishh’s technology platform as a
**cloud-native, API-first, modular and AI-native architecture designed for an Agentic AI future**

. The preferred technology ecosystem will include
**Python and TypeScript/Node.js**

, modern web frameworks such as
**React/Next.js**

,
**PostgreSQL and NoSQL/vector databases**

, containerised microservices using
**Docker/Kubernetes**

, and scalable cloud infrastructure on
**AWS/Azure/GCP**

. The AI layer will leverage
**LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graphs, MCP, tool/function calling and multi-agent orchestration frameworks**

, with the flexibility to work across leading foundation models and open-source models rather than becoming dependent on a single AI provider. The architecture should enable autonomous AI Agents to securely interact with our
**futuristic N2N Marketplace, WMS, OMS, TMS, ERP, e-commerce, logistics and external partner systems through APIs and event-driven workflows**

. We are looking for an engineer who can help us make the right technology choices in discussion with the core team while designing an architecture capable of evolving towards
**AI Agents that can reason, plan, execute, collaborate and automate increasingly complex supply-chain and commerce workflows.**

**Why Goldfishh?**

Goldfishh is 6 year old Tech stratup building at the intersection of two enormous ecosystems:

**Physical Supply Chains × Digital Commerce.**
Our operating businesses across warehousing, 3PL, logistics and e-commerce give us something particularly valuable for technology innovation:
**Real customers. Real warehouses. Real inventory. Real transactions. Real operational problems to solve.**

Our ambition is to convert that operating experience into
**disruptive, scalable technology products for the supply-chain and commerce ecosystem.**

**Our founding team comprises BITS Pilani / IIT alumni, bringing deep domain expertise, entrepreneurial experience and strong technology-product DNA. We are now preparing for our first institutional VC fundraise to accelerate the next phase of growth.**
We deliberately stayed away from VC funding in our formative years—choosing to first build the business, prove the model, acquire customers and generate revenues. Now, we believe the time is right to scale with external capital.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to look back a few years from now and say:

**“I helped architect and build that from Day One.”**

**This role could be right for you if…**

You have spent years building technology products, but your next chapter is not about joining another large engineering organisation.

You want
**ownership, experimentation, speed and the opportunity to create something genuinely new.**

If that sounds interesting, we would like to talk.

**Experience:**
10–15+ years

**Domain:**
SaaS | Marketplaces | E-Commerce | Supply Chain | AI

**Education:**
BE / BTech or equivalent, preferably from a premier engineering institution

**Company:**
Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Website:**
www.goldfishh.com

description:

Assume a critical role in defining the future of a globally recognized firm and have a direct and significant effect in a realm tailored for top achievers in site reliability.
  
  
As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial and Investment Bank, you hold a leadership role in your team, demonstrate strong knowledge across multiple technical domains, and advise others on the technical and business issues facing them. Take lead and conduct resiliency design reviews, break up complex problems into digestible work for other engineers, act as a technical lead for medium to large-sized products, and provide advice and mentoring to other engineers.

* Consistently models and champions site reliability culture and practices, documents and shares knowledge within your organization via internal forums and communities of practice
* Leads initiatives to improve the reliability and stability of your team's applications and platforms using data-driven analytics to improve service levels, proactively identifying and solving technology-related bottlenecks in areas of expertise

title: CloudOps Engineer (L2)
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L2) is responsible for providing advanced technical support, incident resolution, and operational management across enterprise IT infrastructure. The role involves diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues, performing administration activities, implementing changes, supporting problem management, and mentoring L1 engineers while ensuring high service availability and SLA compliance.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure Administration & Operations**

* Administer and maintain Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup and GPU infrastructure to ensure high availability and operational stability.
* Perform proactive health checks, capacity monitoring, performance tuning, and preventive maintenance activities.

**Advanced Incident Management**

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve Level 2 infrastructure incidents within defined SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and coordinate with L3 teams for permanent resolution.
* Review escalations from L1 teams and provide technical guidance during incident resolution.
* Participate in Major Incident Management and support service restoration activities.

**Windows Server & Active Directory Administration**

* Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File Services, and Windows services.
* Manage user accounts, organizational units, security groups, permissions, and authentication-related activities.
* Troubleshoot server performance, replication, authentication, and domain-related issues.

**Linux Administration**

* Perform Linux server administration, including user management, package management, service configuration, performance tuning, and security patching.
* Analyze system logs, troubleshoot kernel and OS issues, and optimize server performance.

**Virtualization Administration**

* Administer Cloud native/VMware/Hyper-V environments, including VM provisioning, snapshots, cloning, migration, and resource optimization.
* Monitor hypervisor performance and troubleshoot virtualization platform issues.

**Kubernetes Administration**

* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including node management, workload deployment, pod lifecycle management, namespace administration, and cluster health monitoring.
* Troubleshoot cluster failures, resource constraints, networking, and orchestration issues.

**Storage & Backup Administration**

* Administer enterprise storage systems, LUN provisioning, storage allocation, capacity management, and performance optimization.
* Manage enterprise backup solutions, perform backup validation, restore operations, and troubleshoot backup failures.

**GPU Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer GPU-based infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Monitor GPU utilization, troubleshoot hardware/software issues, perform firmware validation, and coordinate hardware replacement activities.

**Hardware & Data Center Support**

* Diagnose server hardware failures involving CPU, memory, storage, RAID, power supplies, and network interfaces.
* Coordinate hardware replacements with vendors and perform post-maintenance validation.

**Change & Problem Management**

* Execute approved infrastructure changes following organizational change management processes.
* Participate in Problem Management by identifying recurring issues and implementing preventive actions.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor L1 engineers and contribute to operational excellence and automation initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.

**Experience & Educational Requirement**
BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Windows/Linux Administration, Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, Kubernetes, Storage & Backup Administration, Network Operations, GPU Infrastructure Administration, Troubleshooting, Incident, Problem Management and Infrastructure Troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting mission – critical production environments with 24 x 7 operations
* 4–6 years of experience in Hardware Support, Change Management, Documentation, ITIL Processes, Vendor Coordination, Automation (PowerShell/Bash/Python), Operational Reporting, and Team Collaboration.
* Preferred Exposure: Experience working with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform, cloud native virtualization platforms, VMware, Nutanix, Kubernetes/Openshift environments, cloud native storage, Enterprise storage like NetApp & HPE etc. Backup Solution like Commvault & Cloud native backup tools, enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Zoho etc. & ITSM Platform including Manage Engine & Service Now etc. and GPU infrastructure supporting AI/ML workload is preferred

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation. You'll partner closely with customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
You'll work on some of the most challenging AI deployments in the industry, partnering with Fortune 100 organizations to bring cutting-edge AI systems into production. Every engagement influences not only customer success, but also the future direction of the product. If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, You Will**

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 7+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications, or Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 1 year of related experience.

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.

* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Lead Architect
description:

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. **About The Role**

In this role, you will be a strategic leader responsible for designing and delivering complex, large-scale integration, cloud-native environments. You will drive the architectural vision for our clients, ensuring high-performance, secure, and cost-optimized digital transformations.

in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.

title: Architect,Agentic Delivery
description:
PracticeSuite is a fast-growing healthcare technology company dedicated to simplifying healthcare operations through innovative software solutions. Founded in Silicon Valley and headquartered in Tampa Bay, Florida, the company serves more than 92,000 healthcare users across the United States. PracticeSuite provides an integrated platform spanning Practice Management, Electronic Health Records (EHR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Patient Engagement, and AI-powered healthcare solutions. With global teams across the US, India, and Costa Rica. Headquartered in Tampa Bay, Florida, with operations in India including Kochi, Mumbai.

**Responsibilities**

* Governed agentic lifecycle: Design and run the AI development lifecycle with clear inputs, outputs, and review gates at each stage (PRD, BRD, prototype, HLD, LLD, tests, code, security/compliance). Guardrails and artifacts are part of how the team works.
* Solution architecture: Architect solutions for production SaaS — primarily self-hosted, Java-based systems — including services, data, integration, and the infrastructure implications of running in production.
* Quality: Build quality into the path: component tests, test harnesses, and evals. Automated tests are created in parallel with implementation, not after the fact.
* Agentic platform: Select and implement agentic frameworks, skills, and tooling. Manage context and cost so agentic development can run at scale.
* Repeatable patterns: Turn the first live project into reusable skills, templates, and infrastructure the wider engineering organization can adopt.
* Hands-on delivery: Write and review design and code at a senior-developer standard. Until additional engineers join, you and the product partner are the delivery team.
* Collaboration: Partner closely with the product/business hire (problem framing, artifacts, prompting, and human-in-the-loop). Work with security, compliance, and other engineering teams as solutions move toward production.
* Team build: Help hire and mentor two AI-ready engineers as the cell grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Production SaaS: Sound grasp of production SaaS systems using self-hosted, non-cloud technologies. Java strongly preferred.
* System architecture: 3 or more years as Architect or technical lead role. System architecture including infrastructure literacy: how designs are hosted, integrated, observed, and failed over.
* Quality: Grounded foundation in component testing, test harnesses, and making quality executable.
* AI: At least 1 year of direct AI and Agentic development experience. Experience and strong knowledge of AI, including reinforcement learning and related methods — not only wrapping a chatbot API.
* Agentic development and AI development lifecycle: you can name the inputs, outputs, and review gates at each stage and have used them to ship.
* Context and cost: Experience managing context and cost for agentic development at scale (context engineering, routing, caching, evals).
* Engineering craft: Senior-developer command of SOLID, DRY, and production engineering practices. You write and review code.
* Frameworks: Hands-on with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent (including custom harnesses).
* Working style: Highly responsible, dynamic, and an excellent communicator. Comfortable working from Navi Mumbai with US-based leadership, taking limited direction, and still delivering.

**Nice to Have**

* Java and services: Spring Boot, Maven or Gradle, REST/JSON APIs, OpenAPI. Experience with multi-tenant or schema-per-customer SaaS.
* Data: Oracle and/or PostgreSQL in production. Redis or similar for caching. Familiarity with reporting/analytics stacks (e.g. Metabase) a plus.
* AWS: Working knowledge of core services we use and adjacent ones: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch. Ability to reason about hybrid self-hosted plus cloud designs.
* Containers and delivery: Docker in production. ECS or Kubernetes a plus. CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Testing and evals: JUnit, Testcontainers, API contract tests. UI or prototype automation (e.g. Playwright). LLM eval harnesses (LangSmith, Promptfoo, or custom evals).
* Agentic and AI platform: LangGraph, tool calling, MCP, RAG / vector stores, spec-driven development, structured outputs, model routing.
* Observability: Logs, metrics, and traces in production (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, or equivalent).
* UI delivery: React, Next.js, and Flutter.
* Healthcare and security: Healthcare, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or similar regulated environments. FHIR or HL7 familiarity a plus.

**Location:**
Navi Mumbai | Reports to VP of Engineering | Full-time

**Experience:**
3+ years as Architect or Technical Lead role and at least 1 year of direct AI & Agentic development experience

**Work Shift Timing:**
US Shift (11AM to 7 PM)

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of building and scaling our test automation ecosystem — owning quality end-to-end, from test design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust, reliable, and release-ready at all times.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build & maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG.
* Own test strategy for assigned squads — defining scope, coverage, and risk from requirements through production.
* Write BDD feature files (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, and Product stakeholders.
* Implement TDD practices — writing tests before or alongside code to drive quality in development cycles.
* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback.
* Perform API testing and validate end-to-end user journeys across web and services.
* Identify, document & triage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and champion quality best practices across the engineering org.
* Continuously evaluate test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps — iterating to keep automation suite trustworthy.

**What We're Looking For**
**Must-Have Skills**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation in a product engineering environment.
* Strong proficiency with Selenium WebDriver — page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing.
* Solid experience with Cucumber (BDD) — writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks.
* Hands-on with TestNG — test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of TDD principles and integrating tests into agile development workflows.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language — Java or Python preferred.
* Experience with CI/CD integration and running tests in automated pipelines.
* Strong analytical thinking with an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes.
* Excellent communication skills — ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Nice to Have**

* Domain knowledge in Payments — understanding of payment flows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems.
* Experience testing APIs with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar.
* Familiarity with performance / load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6).
* Exposure to cloud testing environments (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm).
* Knowledge of security testing basics relevant to financial or transactional systems.
* Experience with mobile automation (Appium or similar).

**The Mindset We Value**
Beyond technical skills, we hire for how you think and operate:
  
  

* Ownership mindset — you treat quality as your personal responsibility, not a sign-off gate. You proactively identify risks, flag issues early, and see bugs as a systemic problem to solve.
* Shift-left thinking — you involve yourself in requirements and design discussions, not just execution phase.
* Bias for automation — if something is tested manually more than twice, you ask how to automate it.
* Collaborative — you work with developers as partners, not adversaries, and build shared ownership of quality.
* Continuous improvement — you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices, improving coverage, speed, and reliability.

title: Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
VMware NSX-T Data Center
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
HCX Core Support
  
  
Deploy and configure VMware HCX Connector, HCX Manager, and Service Mesh appliances across source and destination sites
  
  
Support bi-directional VM migrations using vMotion, Bulk Migration, Cold Migration, and Replication Assisted vMotion (RAV)
  
  
Manage HCX site pairing, fleet upgrades, and appliance lifecycle operations
  
  
Troubleshoot HCX interconnect, WAN optimization, and tunnel failures
  
  
MON — Mobility Optimized Networking
  
  
Configure and manage HCX Network Extension with MON to enable migrated VMs to reach segments within the SDDC without sending packets back to the source environment router Broadcom
  
  
Set Target Router Location (Cloud/On-premises) at per-VM granularity for vMotion- and RAV-migrated workloads
  
  
Configure and validate MON policy routes that define which traffic is routed through the source gateway versus traffic routed through the cloud gateway Broadcom
  
  
Diagnose and resolve network tromboning issues on Layer-2 extended segments
  
  
Enable/disable MON at the time of stretching a network or on already extended networks, and on an individual VM basis for VMs residing on extended networks in the SDDC Broadcom
  
  
NSX & Network Integration
  
  
Ensure NSX Tier-1 router is connected to a Tier-0 router in the cloud environment prior to enabling MON, and that Layer-2 network extensions terminate correctly on Tier-1
  
  
Validate NSX requirements for extended segments and troubleshoot Gateway/DHCP IP conflicts
  
  
Work with NSX-T constructs (T0/T1, segments, distributed routing) in destination SDDC environments
  
  
Cloud Platform Support
  
  
Support HCX deployments on VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, or Google Cloud VMware Engine
  
  
Ensure HCX Enterprise license activation for MON features
  
  
Coordinate with cloud platform teams for SDDC Compute Gateway configuration related to MON
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
6 - 7 years of experience in VMware virtualization and data center infrastructure
  
  
Hands-on experience with VMware HCX deployment and operations (HCX 4.x preferred)
  
  
Solid understanding of Mobility Optimized Networking (MON) and how it prevents network tromboning on extended L2 segments
  
  
Strong NSX-T knowledge: T0/T1 routers, segments, distributed firewall
  
  
Familiarity with VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter, vMotion, DRS)
  
  
Understanding of L2 network extension, VLAN stretching, and hybrid cloud networking
  
  
Experience with VMware Cloud on AWS or Azure VMware Solution is a plus
  
  
Knowledge of HCX Enterprise licensing requirements for MON activation
  
  
Proficiency in network troubleshooting (packet capture, routing tables, MTU/path analysis)
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**
VMware certifications: VCP-NV, VCP-DCV, VCAP, or HCX Specialist
  
  
Exposure to Broadcom/VMware support portal and KB-based troubleshooting
  
  
Scripting skills for automation (PowerCLI, Python, REST API for HCX)
  
  
Experience with FHRP (HSRP/VRRP) interactions with MON (a known compatibility consideration in HCX 4.7+)
  
  
Familiarity with HCX HA (High Availability) for Network Extension appliances
  
  
Key Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset for complex hybrid cloud network issues
  
  
Ability to collaborate across infrastructure, cloud, and network teams
  
  
Customer-facing support experience (L2/L3 escalation handling)
  
  
Clear documentation skills for runbooks and migration plan.

title: Lead, Software Development/Engineering
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**The Role**
: Backend Engineer (Microservices Transformation)
  
  
**The Team:**
Establish FRA Prototype Team & Delivery Approach
  
  
A full-scale microservices transformation of the S&P Global’s Financial Risk Analytics product, pre-AI, was expected to require a large pool of technology roles across architecture, engineering, platform, security, operations, and delivery.
  
  
For the initial FRA prototype transformation, we want to stand up a lean, generative-AI enabled transformation squad with a focused team structure sized to deliver a validated microservices foundation.
  
  
The objective is to establish an agile technology transformation group to design and deliver a commercially aligned, targeted microservices architecture for the FRA platform, prioritizing measurable business outcomes and rapid learnings.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Play a central role in building the organisation’s next-generation digital platform, developing microservices and backend components that power interactive and near-real-time customer experiences.
* Design and deliver high-quality domain microservices, REST/ GraphQL APIs, and event-driven integrations that enable scalable, decoupled, and future-ready systems.
* Engineer robust asynchronous workflows and event consumers/producers, helping create resilient services that perform reliably in complex distributed environments.
* Own the design and optimisation of service-owned data stores, supporting performance, scalability, and the successful migration of data from legacy monolithic platforms.
* Drive engineering excellence through unit testing, integration testing, performance tuning, and active code review, ensuring every release meets high standards of quality and maintainability.
* Contribute to operational confidence by monitoring live services, resolving incidents, and continuously improving observability to support secure, stable, and high-performing production systems.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Key qualifications for the job**

* Generative AI Development & Integration (Microservices and APIs)
* Scala, Java / Spring Boot and/ or .NET and / or Python
* SQL / NoSQL/ Cassandra/ HBase/ Spark/ Yarn
* Docker
* Git

**Key Soft Skills**

* Collaborative problem-solving — Success in a microservices environment depends on working effectively across engineering, product, platform, and architecture teams. This role needs someone who can solve issues collectively, contribute constructively in design discussions, and build strong technical partnerships.
* Ownership and accountability — The strongest candidates take responsibility for service quality end to end, from build and test through to production support. They are proactive, dependable, and committed to resolving issues rather than handing them off.
* Adaptability and learning agility — Modernisation programs evolve quickly, especially when integrating with legacy platforms and near-real-time systems. This role requires someone who can absorb new domain knowledge fast, adapt to changing priorities, and remain effective in a fast-moving environment.
* Attention to quality and operational discipline — Building backend services is not just about writing code; it requires a mindset of precision, reliability, and continuous improvement. The individual should care deeply about testing, performance, observability, and building services that are resilient in production.

**Additional Key Qualifications For The Job**

* Kubernetes
* Messaging platforms
* Event streaming
* Cloud-native development

**Additional Soft Skills**

* Systems thinking — In Kubernetes, messaging, and event-streaming environments, issues rarely sit in one component. Engineers need to understand how services, containers, infrastructure, queues, events, and data flows interact so they can anticipate downstream impact, design more resilient solutions, and troubleshoot effectively across the whole system rather than just their own code.
* Clear technical communication — Cloud-native and event-driven architectures create more service boundaries, contracts, and operational dependencies. Engineers must communicate clearly with platform teams, other service owners, and product stakeholders to avoid misunderstanding around APIs, event schemas, ownership, deployment changes, and incident response.
* Adaptability and continuous learning — Kubernetes, cloud-native practices, and distributed integration patterns evolve quickly, and real-world implementations often differ from ideal architecture. The role needs someone who can learn fast, absorb new patterns, and adjust to changing tooling, operating models, and migration realities without losing delivery momentum.
* Operational composure and resilience — Distributed systems fail in more complex ways: delayed messages, replay issues, scaling problems, noisy alerts, and intermittent production faults. Engineers need to stay calm under pressure, work methodically through ambiguity, and make sound decisions during incidents to protect service reliability and business continuity.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
**Role: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer**

**Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai (4 days working from office)**

**Work Timings: Office work from 12:00pm to 5:00pm and then remote 7:30pm to 10:00pm**

As a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer within the Product organization, you will be responsible for solving most complex and challenging technical problems, and unlock delivery of value for services that power the PitchBook platform. You will be essential in applying your broad and deep experience in technology, problem solving abilities and ability to conduct hands on solution exploration and experimentation to guide technical teams, and enable them to build and release exceptional solutions relied upon and used by thousands of PitchBook customers every day; you will work with PitchBook professionals around the world with the collective goal of delighting our customers and growing our business.

The teams will rely on your broad and deep experience in building and delivering comprehensive cloud solutions, and lean on your expertise in trade-off analysis and ability to identify options for the problems to solve and validate the right architecture and design with hands on. With your strong analytical skills, you’ll be able to break down abstract and complex problems into smaller problems and apply Domain Driven Design approaches such as identifying bounded contexts and establish decomposition process. You will be expected to devise solutions based on limited information and precedent to find creative ways to tackle challenges. It is essential that you will be able to interpret, assess and resolve a wide range of issues and be able to select the right course of action.

You will collaborate with the PitchBook Architecture Team, as well as many internal stakeholders of different roles, backgrounds, who may have varying degrees of understanding of the domain. You may need to adapt your style of communication based on the audience you are interacting with and will be relied on to influence decisions to build optimal solutions to complex challenges. Additionally, as a technical expert in a broad set of domains, you will be expected to engage actively in promoting architecture guidelines, principles, and practices across team(s), and be a driver for consistency and alignment for cross cutting concerns.

Lastly, you exhibit a growth mindset, willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. If you love building customer-centric solutions, strive for excellence every day, are adaptable and focused, and believe work should be fun, come join us!

**Primary Job Responsibilities:**

* Hands-on development will be a large part of the responsibilities.
* Quickly learn and trial hands on new technology, assess and validate assumptions, identify flows or risks that support the technical directions.
* Ensure qualities/non-functional requirements of the platforms and products are defined, measurable and are continuously evaluated to deliver the right product to our users.
* Document technical designs, communicate, elaborate with architects and other teams
* Implement well-designed, testable, and efficient code that meets product requirements, coding standards, performance, scalability, reliability, and the organization’s goals and principles, which can be used as reference implementation by other teams.
* Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and other internal stakeholders in an Agile environment.
* Provide technical guidance with different team members.
* Design and deliver on end-to-end initiatives with little to no guidance.
* Define and participate in processes that improve products using return on experience, root cause analysis of incidents.
* Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors.
* Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested.
* Mentor and assist developing junior roles including Staff Software Development Engineers.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a similar field.
* Minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience
* 8+ years in Software Development or Engineering roles.
* 6+ years of experience with Java or a similar object-oriented language.
* 4+ years of experience developing micro service.
* Experienced in Service-Oriented & Microservices Architecture, Cloud Architecture, Domain Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, Domain Driven Design
* Fluent in identifying and applying architecture patterns, designing RESTful API
* Have worked on middleware, platform, or system of systems.
* Experienced with web technologies and standards (e.g., JSON, JWT).
* Experienced with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experienced in Spring Boot/Spring Framework.
* Experienced with Container orchestration software (e.g., Kubernetes).
* Highly experienced working within development teams in an Agile environment.
* Ability to handle a project through the entire software development lifecycle, end to end.
* Demonstrate ability to lead and/or provide guidance to junior peers across multiple teams.
* Excellent technical communication skills, written and verbal.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving ability.
* Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite including in-depth knowledge of Outlook, Word and Excel with the ability to pick up new systems and software easily.

**Working Conditions**

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events. Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Vice President, Corporate Technology
description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
Ares is seeking a
**Corporate Technology India Lead, Engineering (Vice President)**
to join Corporate Technology in Mumbai, reporting to the global
**Head of Corporate Technology**
. This is a high-impact role serving as the senior Corporate Technology leader in India and a member of the Corporate Technology leadership team alongside the global Product and Engineering heads. The leader will provide local direction and connective leadership for up to 15 Mumbai-based employees supporting Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, and Corporate Services Technology - including colleagues aligned through dotted-line reporting - and support oversight of a comparable contractor workforce of approximately 15. While retaining direct accountability for engineering delivery and operational excellence, this individual will help create a cohesive local technology community of approximately 30 internal and external professionals.
  
  
This is a build-and-scale opportunity for a leader who wants to shape how the India Corporate Technology organization engineers, operates, and adopts AI. The role has meaningful influence over engineering culture, talent strategy, delivery practices, process maturity, knowledge management, and the evolution of business-critical platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on full-stack engineering leader and credible technologist who combines deep technical judgment with strong people and organizational leadership. This person will operate as a player-coach: contributing directly to architecture, design, code reviews, prototypes, critical development, and production problem solving, while building a high-performing team. They will bring an AI-centric mindset and a practical record of using AI and automation to improve software delivery, business workflows, decision support, and team productivity within appropriate governance and control frameworks.
  
  
Success requires exceptional written and verbal communication, strong executive presence, and the ability to create clarity across cultures, time zones, and matrixed reporting lines. The leader must be a trusted bridge-builder across Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Information Security, Infrastructure, Service Management, and business-facing technology teams. They must be equally effective with engineers, product managers, senior business stakeholders, and enterprise technology partners, translating complex topics into crisp decisions, shared priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Success in this role will be reflected in the strength, cohesion, and engagement of the India technology community; clear direction across direct and dotted-line teams; predictable, high-quality delivery; improved platform reliability and engineering productivity; responsible adoption of AI; and durable processes and knowledge assets that reduce key-person dependency and allow the organization to scale.
  
  
**Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities**

* Serve as the Corporate Technology site leader in Mumbai and a member of the Corporate Technology leadership team; contribute to technology strategy, portfolio priorities, workforce planning, operating model, and culture.
* Provide visible, day-to-day direction, prioritization, and connective leadership for up to 15 Mumbai-based Product and Engineering colleagues across Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, and Corporate Services, including individuals whose formal reporting lines sit with global leaders; align objectives, capacity, ways of working, development, and the local team experience in partnership with their direct managers.
* Lead through influence in a matrixed global model with exceptional communication and follow-through; build trust, establish clear accountabilities, surface risks early, explain tradeoffs, facilitate difficult conversations, resolve cross-team friction, and maintain strong alignment across Mumbai, New York, and Los Angeles.
* Own engineering delivery and operational health across assigned Corporate Technology solutions, ensuring applications and platforms are scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable, and audit-ready.
* Remain hands-on as a full-stack engineer: contribute to solution architecture and design, build prototypes and critical components, review code, troubleshoot complex issues, and support high-severity production incidents.
* Partner with Product leaders and business stakeholders to translate roadmaps and business needs into clear technical requirements, architecture decisions, delivery plans, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.
* Define and execute an AI and automation agenda for Corporate Technology in Mumbai, in partnership with global Product, Engineering, Data, Architecture, Information Security, and relevant control functions; prioritize use cases based on business value, feasibility, risk, and adoption.
* Drive practical, responsible adoption of AI across the software delivery lifecycle and corporate workflows, including assisted development, testing, documentation, knowledge discovery, incident analysis, workflow automation, summarization, and decision support, with appropriate data protection, human oversight, evaluation, auditability, and monitoring.
* Establish disciplined operating rhythms and a strong process and knowledge-management culture, including architecture decision records, engineering standards, reusable patterns, design reviews, runbooks, playbooks, onboarding materials, communities of practice, retrospectives, and measurable continuous-improvement actions; use AI-enabled tools to make knowledge current, discoverable, and reusable.
* Own end-to-end solution delivery: discovery, architecture/design, build/configuration, data and integration work, testing/UAT, release, adoption, and production support, aligned with SDLC, change management, and operational readiness expectations.
* Establish and reinforce common engineering standards across the portfolio, including code quality, peer review, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, environment management, observability, documentation, and release governance.
* Guide the design of modern applications, services, APIs, workflows, and data flows; make pragmatic decisions that balance strategic modernization, reuse, time to value, platform constraints, control requirements, and total cost of ownership.
* Act as a bridge across Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data/Analytics, Infrastructure/Cloud, Service Management, and adjacent application teams; clarify ownership, resolve seams, manage dependencies, and ensure alignment with cybersecurity, identity/access, data governance, privacy, records retention, resiliency, and responsible AI standards.
* Drive operational excellence through proactive monitoring, capacity and performance management, incident/problem management, root-cause analysis, technical debt reduction, runbooks, service metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Build, coach, and retain strong engineering talent in Mumbai; provide local coaching, performance input, and development direction for direct and dotted-line colleagues in partnership with their formal managers; contribute to hiring, succession planning, technical mentorship, and targeted development opportunities while fostering a culture of ownership, inclusion, transparency, high standards, and continuous learning.
* Support oversight of a contractor and delivery-partner population of comparable scale (approximately 15), including capacity planning, onboarding, work allocation, delivery performance, quality, cost discipline, documentation, knowledge transfer, and vendor escalation; ensure external professionals operate as integrated members of the team while maintaining clear accountability and Ares standards.
* Provide concise, transparent, executive-ready reporting and written decision materials on delivery, platform health, engineering quality, AI adoption, talent, risks, issues, dependencies, and remediation plans.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive technology experience, including significant hands-on full-stack software engineering and enterprise application delivery.
* 5+ years of people and organizational leadership experience, with a proven record leading senior engineers and multidisciplinary teams through a combination of direct, dotted-line, and influence-based leadership; experience providing direction to organizations of comparable scale is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach, balancing direct technical contribution with portfolio delivery, team leadership, and executive engagement.
* Experience serving as a local engineering or site leader, with accountability for talent, culture, delivery coordination, process maturity, senior escalation management, and the effective integration of employees, contractors, and globally aligned teams.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI and automation to engineering practices and/or enterprise business workflows, with the judgment to move from experimentation to secure, governed, measurable adoption.
* Experience in complex, regulated financial services; alternative asset management experience strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree required; Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are essential, including the ability to synthesize complex information, write crisp executive materials, influence senior stakeholders, build durable relationships, resolve conflict constructively, and create alignment across regions, cultures, and technology functions.

**Experience Required**

* Deep full-stack engineering expertise and recent hands-on delivery experience, including:

+ Proficiency in at least one modern backend stack (e.g., Java/Spring, C#/.NET, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or comparable)
+ Proficiency in at least one modern web framework (e.g., React, Angular, or comparable), with a strong understanding of user experience, performance, and secure development
+ Strong SQL, relational data modeling, data analysis/troubleshooting, and comfort navigating complex process and data flows
+ Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, services, event/messaging patterns, and batch integrations
+ Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, cloud or modern enterprise hosting, containers where applicable, and application observability

* Practical fluency with enterprise AI solution patterns and AI-assisted engineering, with demonstrated ability to move valuable use cases into governed production adoption; familiarity with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, observability, and secure data grounding is strongly valued.
* Proven ability to establish scalable engineering processes and knowledge-management disciplines that improve quality, onboarding, reuse, supportability, and organizational resilience.
* Strong software architecture fundamentals, including modular design, scalability, resiliency, security, maintainability, integration, data, and control considerations.
* Demonstrated success delivering and operating business-critical enterprise applications through the full SDLC, including testing, release/change management, adoption, production support, incident/problem management, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications and platforms while managing operational risk, controls, business continuity, and stakeholder change.
* Proven success leading multiple teams or a portfolio across different business domains, including directing work across direct and dotted-line employees and external partners; able to prioritize and sequence work in partnership with Product leaders.
* Strong people leadership capabilities, including hiring, coaching, performance management, career development, succession planning, and building inclusive, high-performing engineering cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to build bridges across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Infrastructure, Service Management, and adjacent technology functions, creating clarity, trust, shared accountability, and momentum across global time zones and organizational boundaries.
* Experience managing vendors, systems integrators, or external engineering partners at meaningful scale, including capacity planning, performance management, documentation, knowledge transfer, cost control, and operational readiness.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Corporate Technology domains such as Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, procurement/expense, workplace, or other Corporate Services.
* Experience with one or more core ERP or finance ecosystems (e.g., Oracle, Workday, or comparable), including integrations, master/reference data, controls, close/reporting dependencies, and multi-entity or multi-currency operations.
* Experience supporting a public company or similarly controlled environment, with familiarity with SOX/internal controls, audit, financial reporting, segregation of duties, evidence retention, and enterprise risk management expectations.
* Prior involvement in ERP modernization, finance transformation, enterprise platform rationalization, or other large-scale process and technology transformation programs.
* Experience building or scaling an engineering organization or capability center in Mumbai while integrating it into a global Product and Engineering model.
* Experience with cloud migration, application modernization, enterprise workflow and low-code platforms, automation, data platforms, and engineering productivity initiatives.
* Familiarity with engineering, AI adoption, knowledge-management, and operational metrics used to improve delivery predictability, quality, reliability, developer experience, and business outcomes.

**General Requirements**

* Strong ownership mindset with disciplined, outcomes-focused execution; able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and translating evolving business needs into durable technical solutions, clear decisions, and actionable team direction.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and service-oriented approach; a natural connector who can build credibility with engineers, Product partners, business stakeholders, control functions, and peer technology leaders, and who proactively connects teams, resolves friction, and advances shared outcomes.
* High standards, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous-learning mindset, with a commitment to remaining technically engaged while operating effectively at Vice President and leadership-team level.
* Willingness to flex hours as needed to support global leadership forums, stakeholders, critical releases, and production needs across India and U.S. time zones.

**Reporting Relationships**
Head of Business Operations Systems
  
  
*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.
  
  
As Bluehost scales from millions toward tens of millions of customers, DevOps is the team that makes sure every other team can ship fast without breaking things. You'll own the pipelines, cloud-native infrastructure, and observability that keep our platform fast, safe, and reliable, modernizing legacy pieces along the way and using AI tooling to move faster than a team our size normally could.
  
  
**What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark**

* Design, build, and operate Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure across AWS, GCP, Azure, and/or OCI, covering compute, storage, networking, and IAM
* Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, version-controlled in Git and aligned with team-wide best practices across environments
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Argo (CD/Workflows), automating build, test, and release for dozens of services
* Drive release and deployment management practices, including progressive rollouts, rollback strategy, and change management that reduces risk without slowing teams down
* Configure and harden web servers (Apache/Nginx), virtual hosts, and SSL/TLS across environments
* Build out observability, metrics, tracing, and log aggregation (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki), with real alerting that catches issues before customers do
* Use AI across the delivery lifecycle — scripting, infrastructure code, root-cause investigation, and runbooks — and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated infrastructure code gets reviewed before it touches production, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer or secret data may enter a prompt
* Own networking fundamentals in production: TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls (iptables/nftables), and load balancing across cloud and on-prem environments
* Carry on-call rotation, lead incident response, and turn postmortems into concrete reliability improvements

**Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles
* Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and cloud-native architecture patterns
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform) plus configuration management tooling (Ansible or Puppet)
* Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Argo, or comparable GitOps tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
* Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, firewall rules, and load balancing in cloud and on-prem environments
* Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki) and building alerting that's actually actionable
* AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just script generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated infrastructure code and automation knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside — review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer or secret data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for.
* Strong Bash and Python scripting ability, with public cloud experience across AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI
* Working knowledge of Linux security fundamentals: TLS, SSH hardening, patch management, and IAM in cloud environments

**Why you’ll love us.**

* We’ve evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences: We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.
* We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!
